events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Blue Earth, MN; Faribault, MN; Freeborn, MN; Steele, MN; Waseca, MN
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1126 PM CDT, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain in southern Waseca county along MN Highway 30
and in New Richland. Between 2 and 5 inches of rain have fallen. The
expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour. Additional
rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 2 inches are possible in the warned area.
Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
New Richland, Ellendale, Minnesota Lake, Geneva, Hartland and
Matawan.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Bernalillo, NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1011 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across the warned area. Between 0.75 and 1 inch of rain has
fallen. Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Eastern Albuquerque and Sandia Heights.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 160 and 168. Interstate 25 between
Mile Markers 221 and 230.

This warning is primarily for the arroyos and diversion channels
within the affected area due to the expected increase in rapidly
flowing water. Please avoid arroyos, diversion channels and any other
areas that are flooded.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Hudspeth, TX
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Hudspeth County in western Texas...

* WHEN...Until midnight MDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1003 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Additional rainfall of up to 0.5 inches is expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sierra Blanca.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Houston, MN
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWARX

The National Weather Service in La Crosse has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Houston County in southeastern Minnesota...

* Until 300 AM CDT.

* At 1059 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Caledonia, Houston, Hokah, Brownsville, Mound Prairie, Money Creek,
Reno, Yucatan, Sheldon, Black Hammer, Highway 44 And Sanden Road,
Beaver Creek Valley State Park, Dun Romin Park Campground, County
14 And White Tail Road, Freeburg, County Roads 3 And 24, Perkins
and County Roads 15 And 4.
